content:
support-ana: Heads-up: multiple customers reporting p95/p99 latency regressions and some 504s for /v1/generate in us-west-2 since ~09:20 UTC. Escalation from acct `acme-inc` — they hit p99 ~3.2s for small prompts. Trace IDs: trace=tr_8a7f. Sample cURL + response attached.

oncall-jess: acknowledging, thanks Ana. I'm looking at pod queues and autoscaler metrics now. @sre-matt can you check router queue lengths and any recent deploys to us-west-2? :mag_right:

sre-matt: saw a short autoscaler thrash around 09:18 — scale down then back up, some pods were in CrashLoop for ~90s. Router backlog spiked. Pulling logs for model-serving pods. Might be a bad model weight load causing slower first-token times.

eng-runtime-ryan: I can confirm increased first-token latency on one GPU pool (gw-03). KV cache miss rate jumped. Possible kernel OOM leading to slower evictions. No new model pushes in last 2 hours though.

prod-liz: Customer-facing queue: raising priority. Suggest we failover eligible traffic to fallback region or model-variant to reduce tail impact while we fix the pool.

oncall-jess: Agreed. Mitigation plan (quick):
1) Open circuit-breaker for heavy customers to P95 guardrail (temporary throttling)
2) Route non-SLA traffic to eu-west-1 fallback pool
3) Reduce max_batch_size on gw-03 to force smaller, faster batches
4) Promote cached model variant for small prompts (prefix cache)
5) If nets stable, drain gw-03 and recycle nodes

sre-matt: executing step 3 and 5 now. Patch to router to lower batch size:

```json
{
  "pool": "gw-03",
  "max_batch_size": 8,
  "queue_window_ms": 10
}
```

curl -X POST "https://router-admin.internal/v1/pools/gw-03/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d @config.json

oncall-jess: step 1 (circuit breaker) — using adhoc rate-limit to throttle top 5% noisy keys to 10r/s. Command:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://slo-gate.internal/blocks" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"keys": ["acct:acme-inc","acct:beta-co"], "limit_rps": 10, "duration_s": 600}'
```

support-ana: I've notified acme-inc that we're applying mitigations; gave a suggested temporary config (reduce concurrency) and asked for sample traffic patterns. They appreciate the quick response.

eng-runtime-ryan: also toggled prefix KV caching to on for small-prompt route. This should reduce repeated prefix recompute. Command used:

```text
runtimectl enable-cache --route small-prompts --ttl 300
```

deployer-bot: deploy/gw-03: rollout start 2901234578 by sre-matt

deployer-bot: deploy/gw-03: pods terminating -> new pods creating

sre-matt: draining gw-03 now, moving steady traffic to gw-01 and eu-west-1. Monitoring p95/p99.

incident-bot: alert suppressed: latency_us-west-2_p99 high -> mitigation in progress

oncall-jess: Observed p95 improved from 1.1s -> 0.6s and p99 from 3.2s -> 0.9s after throttles + routing changes. Still watching. If p99 stays >1s for 10m, escalate to infra to check kernel drivers.

prod-liz: Good. Action item: create a short postmortem checklist and add automated playbook to run these steps with one-click failover for us-west-2. Include rollback criteria and customer communication template.

sre-matt: opened ticket INF-4721 to add playbook. Draft steps included in ticket: quick circuit-breaker script, route-failover script, batch-size toggle, cache toggle, drain+recycle. Will link runbook after cleanup.

oncall-jess: Thanks team. I'll keep thread open for 30m then close once metrics stable for 15m. :white_check_mark:

support-ana: Customer updated — latency looks better for them. Closing their escalations for now, will reopen if they see regressions.

eng-runtime-ryan: postmortem note: add health-check on model load latency and guard in autoscaler to avoid rapid down-up cycles when kernel OOMs occur.

sre-matt: final: gw-03 recycled, no further errors in last 20m. P99 baseline back to expected. Logging full trace to INF-4721.

oncall-jess: closing thread in 5m if stable. Thanks everyone. :pray:
